description: Lifecycle endpoint discovery, actual listener selection, explicit overrides, local readiness v2 and trusted proxy integration.

comments.text: Implemented uncached discovery from registered widget endpoint metadata, actual listener selection and explicit disambiguation. Readiness v2 separates local handshake evidence from external HTTPS (not_checked). Endpoint-owned trusted proxy normalization precedes HTTP and socket dispatch; public origin defaults to endpoint HTTPS URL. Real TLS proxy acceptance verifies Secure/Partitioned cookies and WSS over HTTP backend without spoofed readiness headers.

title: Discover widget endpoints and support proxy HTTPS readiness
